cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Merciful Lie
cards.instruction: Choose a truth your character believes would hurt someone. Keep it from them, even as honesty becomes harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The editor called your poem spare, so I've left two blank pages beside it in your booklet. A very confident choice of word.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Spare was the heading for unused pages. Under my poem he wrote doesn't work. I should stop writing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Doesn't work there. It needs its own space, just as I've given it. Keep the poem in the booklet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you put your name under a recommendation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. 'Give this poem the space it deserves.' Put my name right under it. I'll hand the editor his copy myself.
